basic_details.job_title: IIIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Deputy Registrar, Technical Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: IIIT Allahabad (Indian Institute of Information Technology Allahabad) has advertised 2 posts for internal candidates only: 1 Deputy Registrar (Level-12) and 1 Technical Officer (SS) (Level-11), both on promotional basis. Applications must be submitted by hand to the Deputy Registrar (Estt.), Establishment Section, and must reach by 10 December 2026, 05:00 PM, under Advt. No. Estt./PR-NT/03/2026.

A candidate found ineligible at any stage is disqualified and the candidature is cancelled. Hiding information or giving false or misleading information also leads to cancellation at any stage. The Institute reserves the right to reject any application without giving a reason. Preference is given to Persons with Disabilities (PwD), even where reservation is not indicated in the vacancy table, provided suitable PwD candidates are available and meet the eligibility criteria. The Institute reserves the right to assign or transfer the selected candidate to any section, department or office within the Institute. content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Information Technology Allahabad (IIIT Allahabad)
Deputy Registrar: Level-12; Technical Officer (SS): Level-11 (Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC)
Experience-based for Deputy Registrar; B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc./MCA with experience for Technical Officer (SS)
By hand, with the form enclosed with the notice
10 December 2026, 05:00 PM (applications received after the closing date and time are rejected)

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: The notice describes IIIT Allahabad as an Institute of national importance declared under an Act of Parliament to provide for education and research in IT-focused and allied branches of Engineering, Technology, Applied Sciences and Management Studies. Its address is Deoghat Jhalwa, Prayagraj-211015 (U.P.). The vacancies are issued by its Establishment Section as an internal promotional vacancy in the administrative and technical cadre.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The complete application, with all supporting documents duly self-attested, must be submitted by hand to: Deputy Registrar (Estt.), Establishment Section, Admin. Extension Block-I, West Wing, IIIT Allahabad. Deadline: on or before 10 December 2026, till 05:00 PM. Envelope: superscribe it with Application for the post of "____" (as applicable) (Promotional Vacancy) – Advt. No.: Estt./PR-NT/03/2026 dated 19.11.2026. Form: the notice encloses the form "Application for IIIT-A Non-Teaching Employees". It asks for name, marital status, father's/husband's name, addresses, contact details, date of birth, nationality, date of joining at IIIT-Allahabad and in the present designation, MACP upgradation, category (SC, ST, OBC, GEN, PH), academic record and employment particulars. The completed application must be forwarded by the Head/Section In-charge. After submission, the applicant should retain a copy of the submitted application.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Pay is given as the Pay Matrix Level as per the 7th CPC. The notice prints no rupee amount. Essential qualification with experience: 08 years administrative experience as Assistant Registrar in PB-3 with GP Rs. 5400 / or Pay Matrix Level-10 as per 7th CPC. The notice prints no separate educational qualification for this post. Essential qualification with experience: B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc./MCA with 08 years of experience as Technical Officer in PB-3 with GP-5400 (Pay Matrix Level-10 as per 7th CPC). Age limit: the age limit prescribed for the posts is not applicable for regular employees of IIIT Allahabad. Mode of appointment: both posts are to be filled on promotional basis. Date for determining eligibility in every respect: the closing date, 10 December 2026, 05:00 PM. Candidates should check the official notification for each post's eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The completed application form. All relevant supporting documents, duly self-attested. Xerox copies of Degree Certificate with the academic record. Attested copy of the Caste Certificate in the Government of India format, for SC/ST and OBC-NCL candidates; the certificate must be issued by an authorized officer only.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinised first, and only scrutiny-cleared applicants are called for the selection process. Written test (if applicable) and presentation-cum-interview: the final selection is based on performance in these, along with overall qualifications and experience. Meeting the stated qualifications does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for the written test (if applicable) or the presentation-cum-interview. The screening and selection criteria are as per RPN and the prevailing practice followed for promotional recruitment.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Deputy Registrar (Level-12) and 1 Technical Officer (SS) (Level-11). Both are in the UR category and are promotional vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted by hand on or before 10 December 2026, till 05:00 PM. Applications received after the closing date and time are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The Institute is looking for suitable internal candidates, and the posts are to be filled on promotional basis. The application must be forwarded by the Head/Section In-charge.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Deputy Registrar?
faq.answer: The notice requires 08 years administrative experience as Assistant Registrar in PB-3 with GP Rs. 5400 / or Pay Matrix Level-10 as per 7th CPC. It prints no separate educational qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Technical Officer (SS)?
faq.answer: The qualification is B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc./MCA with 08 years of experience as Technical Officer in PB-3 with GP-5400 (Pay Matrix Level-10 as per 7th CPC).

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice states that the age limit prescribed for the posts is not applicable for regular employees of IIIT Allahabad.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: Deputy Registrar is at Level-12 and Technical Officer (SS) at Level-11 of the Pay Matrix as per the 7th CPC. The notice prints no rupee amount.

faq.question: Q8. How do I submit the application?
faq.answer: Complete the enclosed application form, attach self-attested supporting documents, and submit it by hand to the Deputy Registrar (Estt.), Establishment Section, Admin. Extension Block-I, West Wing, IIIT Allahabad. Write the post and Advt. No. Estt./PR-NT/03/2026 on the envelope.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised and scrutiny-cleared applicants are called. Final selection is based on the written test (if applicable) and presentation-cum-interview, with overall qualifications and experience.
